definition: the very highest point something reaches
description: An outdoor basketball court at dusk with blue and orange paint, a wire fence and tall flats behind. A tall young man in a white vest and black shorts rises in an enormous jump, one arm fully stretched up with the ball above the rim, reaches the highest point, slams the ball through the hoop and hangs on the rim. He drops back down and lands in a deep crouch. A shorter young man in a navy kit stands nearby, and a row of friends in bright jackets by the fence cheer with raised arms.

en.question: What is the man in white doing?

de.question: Was macht der Mann in Weiß?
